svg.aria-label: How I worked: Discovery and design: partnered with risk and compliance experts to map the review process, gather requirements and design the architecture; proposed improvements beyond scope. Stakeholders: ran live demos for senior management and for the risk users. Production delivery: shipped through code review, automated testing and CI/CD.
